notes: Music, video and calls now each get the right latency. Earlier the buffer could grow large enough to throw video out of lip-sync — now there's a Music / Video / Call switch on the sender. Music buffers generously so it never drops; Video and Call stay tight (~100ms) so the screen stays in sync and conversation feels natural. The app even pre-picks the mode for you (mic in use → Call, a video app up front → Video) and you can override it. Update both Macs.
